Exactly one isolated complete subject, a readable front/three-quarter selection pose, not a combat side sprite. Transparent RGBA background, no floor, shadows, aura, scenery, text, title, frame, UI, aiming reticle or bullet marks. Three-quarter view in a single natural hovering pose with both whole wings visible and distinctly separated. Keep the modest true body structure visible in the screenshots. No humanoid torso, bird feathers, extra insect legs, expressive cartoon face or invented tail.

correctionSpec.prompt: Edit this exact existing transparent 2D combat sprite only to correct framing. Preserve the entire design, right-facing lateral idle pose, all proportions, textures, hands, feet, triangular rusted helmet, wrapped legs, layered brown apron and the complete long blade trailing to the left. Reframe the complete subject smaller within a landscape transparent canvas so there is a generous 8–10% completely empty transparent margin above the highest helmet tip, below both soles, and beyond both the blade tip and the forwardmost helmet/hand. Nothing may touch an edge. Keep a true RGBA transparent background with no ground shadow, colored halo, text or scenery. Do not change the pose, add any new objects or crop any extremity.
